field.label: Enable
field.help: Report this firewall to a UniFi Network controller as a UniFi gateway.

field.label: Controller inform URL
field.help: The controller's inform address, usually http://<controller>:8080/inform. Once the gateway shows up in the controller, click Adopt there.

field.label: WAN interface
field.help: Reported as the gateway's WAN port (address, gateway, traffic, DNS).

field.label: LAN interface
field.help: Reported as the gateway's LAN port. Its address and MAC identify the gateway to the controller, and clients seen on it are listed.

field.label: Firmware version
field.help: Leave empty to always report the newest firmware Ubiquiti has released for the model, so the controller never offers an upgrade. Set a version to pin it.

field.label: Hostname
field.help: Hostname reported to the controller. Defaults to this firewall's hostname. To change the device name shown in the controller, rename it there.
